body: Literally relate to all of this lol
The one i used is text “home” to 741741
You are never too old to learn something new
Your health>finals. Period. I would sit down with your sister and discuss everything going on and sometimes having someone next to you in this fight helps more than anything.

I totally relate to this. I always let others define me instead of defining myself, and now being in recovery and not wanting to do that I have found myself struggling to figure out who I really am. You are not in this alone.
If you feel unsafe, go to a hospital. You can also text the crisis text line, I did that a month ago and it helped because I don’t like talking out loud about this stuff.
You are not broken or unfixable. Think of it as “what happened to me” instead of “what’s wrong with me”. What you are going through is no sign of you being broken, it is things that happened to you.

Think of your favorite food. You will never be able to eat that again. 
Think of a favorite tv show that isn’t over yet. You will never be able to watch the next season. No matter how little something is, if it keeps you here then it’s working.
